comparison: Same tests and streams as A1/A2; prior_update=frozen plus prior_code_law=fresh_gaussian; capacity matched by z_dim, draws per update/eval and marginal scale.
conclusion: Fresh N(0,I) latent: 5 PASS / 10 FAIL on the 15 supported sampled-MoG tests (33 blocked by design); identical verdicts to the frozen table; loses ring16_acquisition (hq 0.53) and mode_hold (hq 0.50) vs learned. See reports/prior-ablation-2026-10-25/README.md.

decision_outcomes.reuse_note: Compatible original receipts; overlapping readouts are not independent runs or additive costs

hypothesis: Replacing table codes with fresh N(0, I) latents of the same dimension loses sampled-latent passes that the learned BISPF default holds.
next_action: Stop; the learned table beats an ordinary Gaussian latent on this suite.

study.competing_explanation: The BISPF critic/optimizer, not the particle table, carries the measured passes; an ordinary Gaussian latent matches the learned table.
